name: HumanStandardToken
title: The Silent Token of Constantinople
tagline: A friendly spirit born and stilled on a single summer day.

chapters.heading: The birth of a token
paragraphs: A single candle flickers near a digital grave. The HumanStandardToken arrived on July 31, 2019. A wallet deployed it. It was written in Solidity 0.3.5.

The contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum. It was born into the Constantinople era. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. Now it sits quiet at 7.2 years old.

chapters.heading: A single movement
paragraphs: The HumanStandardToken sits still now. It lived a quiet life with only 1 transaction. People used it once to perform a transfer.
The busy days ended in 2019. It remains a ghost on the chain, silent and alone.

chapters.heading: The long silence
paragraphs: The HumanStandardToken sits still. Its code still rests on the chain like a shadow. It has been quiet for 7.2 years.
The last call came on July 31, 2019. That call was a transfer. It holds 0.0 ETH inside now.

details.text: A wallet starting with 0xafbe and ending in 51c4 brought it into the world.
